title: Active UA probes
sourceDescription: The system requests the current site and competitor pages using configured AI Bot User-Agent strings. Success only means an HTTP 2xx/3xx response; it does not establish an external AI engine visit, indexing, or recommendation.
historyNote: Only records explicitly marked as active UA probes are counted. Historical records with unknown sources and visits identified only by UA are excluded.
allocationNote: Counts depend on keyword labels, target paths, and UA sampling. They do not measure external traffic, share of voice, or search rank. Site grades come from configuration, not engine endorsement.
configuration: Current configuration: {uas} UA entries across {groups} UA groups. These counts use different units.
window: Window: the last {days} days; the first count card covers the last 24 hours.
unattributed: This response lacks active probe source metadata. Legacy counts are hidden and cannot establish external AI visits. Update the server and refresh.
selfShare: Current site's share of successful probes
domainTitle: Current site and competitors — successful active probe counts
empty: No active probe records with an explicit source yet. Start UA probes to check target page responses. This does not cause external AI engines to visit.
keywordTitle: Keyword labels × UA groups — successful probe counts
detailTitle: Active probe details: site × UA group
accepted: Active UA probes were accepted. Refresh later to view successful records. This does not establish external engine crawling or indexing.
runFailed: UA probes could not start. Please try again later.
loadFailed: Probe statistics could not load. Please retry.
